name: Fukui

flag.description: A white disc on a dark navy field, holding the katakana フクイ (Fukui) drawn as a young sprout between two leaves.
flag.symbolism: The prefecture says the sprout rising between two leaves carries its hope for growth.

hook: Fukui's white disc on navy holds a sprouting leaf spelling フクイ (Fukui); Ibaraki's white disc holds a spiral rose bud.
trivia: Sabae, in Fukui, makes about 95% of Japan's eyeglass frames.
Fukui has yielded more dinosaur fossils than anywhere else in Japan.
